## Professional summary

Harpreet is a UX/UI and brand designer with a software engineering background. He designs digital products, brand identities, design systems, and conversion-focused experiences. Work spans mobile apps, healthcare, industrial tech, food branding, and conceptual brand systems. Based in Vienna; experience includes Raiffeisen Software and prior development work.

Skills: User Experience Design, Interface Design, Design Systems, Brand Identity, Prototyping, User Research, Visual Design, Conversion UX.

---

## Case study: Bottle Pirates

- URL: https://harpreet-n.github.io/project/bottle-pirates
- Year: 2025
- Tags: Mobile App, UX/UI Design, Marketplace, Community, Social Commerce

Bottle Pirates (Flaschenpiraten) is a social community marketplace for wine—built for collectors, enthusiasts, and sellers to discover bottles, connect with other members, and trade, buy, or sell wines in a playful treasure-hunt experience. The product blends marketplace mechanics with community interaction.

Problem: Wine trading is high-trust and detail-heavy; listings need clear provenance-style info; experiences can become cluttered.

Solution: Community-first marketplace flow with quick listing creation, browse/filter, discovery-to-conversation with minimal friction, auction mechanics, community profiles, and mobile-first search.

---

## Case study: Weight Loss Program for Online Fitness Coaches

- URL: https://harpreet-n.github.io/project/weight-loss-conversion
- Year: 2025
- Tags: UX/UI, Conversion Optimization, Landing Page, UX Research

Conceptual UX case study on reducing drop-off between social media engagement and paid program enrollment for online fitness coaches. Focus: trust, clarity, and decision support for high-commitment 12-week transformations.

Solution highlights: commitment framing, outcome-oriented CTAs, fear-reduction microcopy, concrete social proof, FAQ addressing motivation and past failure.

## Case study: Gassner Mobile App Redesign

- URL: https://harpreet-n.github.io/project/focasma
- Year: 2025
- Tags: Mobile Redesign, Data Visualization, Industrial Tech

Redesign for Gassner Wägen mobile app (precision weighing / industrial measurement). Improved usability, visual hierarchy, analytics, measurement history, device management, and dashboards for technicians and operators.

## Case study: MyDiabetes Website Redesign

- URL: https://harpreet-n.github.io/project/mydiabetes
- Year: 2023
- Tags: Web Redesign, Healthcare

Redesign of the Diabär association website for children and families affected by diabetes. Goals: accessibility, structure, emotional connection, responsive layout, modular design system, simplified navigation, events, children’s section, educational resources.

Live site reference in case study: https://diabetesvernetzt.at/
